subject: variables are global in R code chunks, but not in Python?

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: variables are global in R code chunks, but not in Python?
parts:
Hi, folks.  I'm trying to use rmarkdown/knitr in "polyglot" mode:

<https://github.com/yihui/knitr-examples/blob/master/106-polyglot.Rmd>

with various code chunks in R, Python, and bash.  It appears that variables defined in R code chunks persist across code chunks; i.e., they appear to be in a global environment.

On the contrary, variables defined in Python code chunks do *not* seem to persist across code chunks.  I'd like to know if there's some way to make the Python behavior the same as the R behavior.

Following the inverse of Yihui's good advice, I posted this issue first on stackoverflow:

<http://stackoverflow.com/questions/32958453/python-code-chunk-variable-persist-across-code-chunk>

where I have an ECM, but I seem to be the only one even looking at the post.  Suggestions welcome.

-- Mike
